headline: Approved a 480-square-foot addition at 359 Carter Avenue with a 4-foot side setback instead of 8 feet.
summary: The meeting considered one appeal from Luis Medeiros for the property at 359 Carter Avenue. The appeal sought a dimensional variance under Section 410-44 of the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance to build a 480-square-foot addition with a 4-foot side setback where 8 feet is required. The appeal was approved 5-0.
decisions: Approved Luis Medeiros's dimensional variance for a 480-square-foot addition at 359 Carter Avenue, 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. McLaughlin motioned to approve the applicant’s appeal for a Dimensional Variance under Section 410-44 of the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance for a 480-square-foot addition to the western side of the existing structure... The appeal was approved with a 5-0 vote.

6. ZONING BOARD OF REVIEW:
APPEAL NO. 1: Luis
 
Medeiros, applicant and owner of the property at 359 Carter Avenue,
further identified as Tax Assessor's Plat 16, Lots 91 and 94, located in an "RS" Residential Single-
Family Zone, is requesting a Dimensional Variance under Section 410-44 of the Pawtucket
Zoning Ordinance.  The applicant is proposing to construct a 480-square-foot addition to the
western side of the existing structure, where a 4-foot side setback is proposed where an 8-foot
setback is required.
A formal hearing was conducted on September 28, 2026
Ms. McLaughlin motioned to approve the applicant’s appeal
 
for a Dimensional Variance under
Section 410-44 of the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance for a 480-square-foot addition to the
western side of the existing structure; a 4-foot side setback is proposed where an 8-foot
setback is required, and was seconded by Ms. McAloon.
